content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking to configure a message text so that it shows the actual temperature from a PT100 sensor in degrees Celsius, instead of displaying the raw sensor value (0-1000). Currently, the AI1 displayed message updates dynamically during simulation, but only shows the 0-1000 value. I would prefer to show the temperature in °C, since the raw value is not meaningful for the end user. Is it possible to present the actual temperature reading?

There is a straightforward approach: Connect AI1 to an "Analog Amplifier" block, setting the sensor type to "PT100/PT1000" and resolution to "x 1". Then, display the amplified value from this block within the message texts block. This will provide you with temperature readings in the range of -50 to +200 as desired.
I have implemented this method and it works perfectly! Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced confusion due to temperature values from a PT100 sensor being shown in a raw format (0-1000) rather than in degrees Celsius, which was unclear for end users. After applying a solution involving the Analog Amplifier block configured for the specific sensor, the user was able to display readable temperature values and confirmed the solution resolved their concern.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the system to present temperature values in degrees Celsius, making readings straightforward and easily understood by end users, rather than displaying sensor raw data.
